src: teal marker pixel s aligned with one row of a red edge bar
dst: row slot d in the opposite equal-height red edge bar
match_cond: s.row offset within its source bar == d.row offset within the opposite bar
transform: on s.row, paint teal from the source red bar to s and recolor s yellow; on d.row, paint a full teal ray from d's red bar to the far edge; preserve red bar pixels
